seo.description: Demo services page for the fictional Servicely™ platform. Setup, migration, AI wiring — all fixed-fee, no 'let's loop in procurement.'

data.headline: # Everything you need to *launch.*
data.lead: From schema design to deploy: a clear menu, fixed scopes, no procurement song-and-dance. This is a demo — the prices below aren't real, we're just rendering the template.

image.alt: Laptop on a warm wooden desk in daylight

data.headline: ## From signup to *live profile* in five days.
data.body:
We mount Servicely™ onto your existing stack — whether that's HubSpot, Airtable, or the Google Sheet your whole team has been living in since 2018.

Included: price-list setup, customer import, a preview environment, and a one-hour handover for the team. After the handover we say 'ping us if anything,' and we mean it.

data.headline: ## Move off your *old CRM,* cleanly.
data.body:
Most migrations stall on three things: duplicate customers, the 'misc' field, and tags created by someone who left two years ago. We've done it eleven times.

Fixed-fee migration: we move the data, dedupe, and leave you with a green CI on day one. No 'oh, we have another old database we forgot about.'

data.headline: ## Wire your *AI agent* into the editor.
data.body:
Whatever AI assistant your team uses — Claude, ChatGPT, in-house — we wire it to Servicely via API. With a proper action history and a log of who the agent accidentally laid off.

Output: a working AI that handles bookings, plus the eval harness to keep it from promising a customer a 70% discount.

data.headline: ## A four-step *engagement.*
data.lead: No discovery deck. No two-week onboarding. Pick a service, we ship.

cards.label: Scoping call
cards.body: Forty-five minutes. We confirm fit and the fixed price. No pre-sales theatre.

cards.label: Repo access
cards.body: You add us to one repo. We work in branches, like adults.

cards.label: Build sprint
cards.body: 5–10 working days. Daily Loom updates, not a 9am standup.
